event_text: Check Point publishes its advisory and fix for CVE-2026-16232, saying it was exploited against a handful of customers; CISA adds it to its exploited-flaws catalog the same day
notes: Date shown on the advisory and in CISA's catalog; no time given.

event_text: Start of the attack activity on Check Point servers that GreyNoise says it confirmed
notes: Date from the GreyNoise report; no time given.

event_text: GreyNoise says the attacker first used its CVE-2026-16232 script against a victim's Check Point server
GreyNoise says a bulk task sent to all 24 compromised Check Point servers fails
notes: 02:17:30 UTC Oct 26 per the GreyNoise report.

event_text: A separate PHP2Shell attack wave against Check Point firewalls begins, per Check Point
notes: Date from Check Point's Nov 12 advisory.

event_text: GreyNoise's last sight of the GT13 attacker
notes: 03:19:46 UTC Nov 2 per the GreyNoise report.

event_text: GreyNoise publishes its report on the campaign
notes: Date on the blog post; no time given.

event_text: BleepingComputer reports the campaign and says it is waiting for Check Point's answer
Check Point tells BleepingComputer it is aware of the activity and that the attackers used CVE-2026-16232
notes: BleepingComputer's update is dated 25/11 with no time.
